comment: All nineteen parameters are declared without a widget, so nothing on this module can be clicked and the entry is a module line plus menu lines. The animation and the scope are drawn over the whole rack from this module's own draw layer (BlankCables.cpp and BlankScope.cpp), and both bail out unless this module is the g_blank singleton set in Blank.cpp:88-90. Scope on MAJ tests the GLFW shift modifier (Blank.cpp:94-95); MAJ is the maker's shorthand for the shift key. The Panel entry is included even though it is cosmetic, because on a blank panel the picture is what the module is for.
